Daily Quiz.question: ১) The correct passive form of ''You must forget it'' is-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) It must be forgotten by you.
Daily Quiz.exp: Active voice-এর বাক্যটাকে passive-এ আনতে যে structure ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে তা হল- active-এর objectকে subject-এ রূপান্তর + modal auxiliary + be + verb-এর past participle form + Active Voice-এর subjectকে object-এ রূপান্তর।

Daily Quiz.question: ২) The phrase ''Hit the sack'' means-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Hit the sack (phrase):
Meaning: to go to bed
Source: lexico.com

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Which is the correct sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The taste of the mangoes is sour
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The taste of the mangoes are sour
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The taste of the mangoes have sour
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The taste of the mangoes have been sour
Daily Quiz.exp:
এখানে মূল subject হল taste, mangoes নয়।
তাই, singular subject-এর number অনুযায়ী verb singular হয়েছে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) The idiom 'back to the drawing board' means-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Back to the drawing board:
Meaning: Used to indicate that an idea, scheme, or proposal has been unsuccessful and that a new one must be devised.
Example: ‘the government must go back to the drawing board and review the whole issue of youth training’

Source: lexico.com

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Choose the correct sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Water is composed with Hydrogen and Oxygen.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Water is composed from Hydrogen and Oxygen.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Water is composed by Hydrogen and Oxygen
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Water is composed of Hydrogen and Oxygen.
Daily Quiz.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থঃ পানি গঠিত হয় হাইড্রোজেন এবং অক্সিজেন দ্বারা।
গঠিত হওয়া অর্থে composed-এর পরে of বসে।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P C Das

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Choose the meaning of the idiom - ''Take someone’s breath away''
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) To challenge the enemy with courage
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Force the enemy to submit
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Inspire someone with awed respect
Daily Quiz.exp:
Take someone’s breath away
Meaning: astonish or inspire someone with awed respect or delight.
‘she took his breath away, as she did most men's’
Source: lexico.com

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Select the correctly spelt word:
Daily Quiz.exp:
Miscellaneous (ADJECTIVE)
Meaning: 1(of items or people gathered or considered together) of various types or from different sources.
Ex: ‘He picked up the miscellaneous papers in his in tray’

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Which one is the correct indirect narration? I said to her, ''Could you give me a cup of tea?''
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I requested her to give me a cup of tea.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) She requested me to give her a cup of tea.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) She requested me to give him a cup of tea.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I requested him to give me a cup of tea.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Could, would দিয়ে শুরু হলে কিছু বাক্য interrogative form না হয়ে অর্থের দিক দিয়ে imperative, তাই এটি to দ্বারা reported speech-এর অংশটুকু যুক্ত করে।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Choose the correct sentence-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) At that point, Franco was desirous for prolonging the war.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) At that point, Franco was desirous of prolonging the war.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) At that point, Franco was desirous in prolonging the war.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) At that point, Franco was desirous with prolonging the war.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Desirous (adjective)
Meaning: desirous (of something/of doing something) | having a wish for something; wanting something.
Source: Oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Choose the correct sentence-
Daily Quiz.exp:
কোন রোগে মারা যাওয়া বোঝাতে die-এর পরে of বসে।
কোন কিছুর প্রভাব বোঝালে die-এর পরে from বসে।
কোন কারণ বোঝালে for বসে। বিষ বোঝালে by বসে।
শান্তিতে মৃত্যু বোঝালে die-এর পরে in বসে।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Choose the correct one-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Maintenance(noun)
mass noun
Meaning: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.
‘we support local initiatives that ensure the maintenance of community spirit’
Source: Oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Choose the correct one:
Daily Quiz.exp:
Conscience (noun):
Meaning: A person's moral sense of right and wrong, viewed as acting as a guide to one's behaviour.
‘He had a guilty conscience about his desires.’

Source: oxfordlearnersdictinaries.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) When a person says he 'can’t wrap his head around something', it means-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He does not understand something
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He has not finished packing
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He has not got everything
Daily Quiz.exp:
Wrap one's head around something (PHRASE):
Meaning: usually with negative understand or come to terms with.

Source: Oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) 'That’s the last straw' means-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) My patience has run out
Daily Quiz.exp:
The last straw (phrase):
Meaning: A further difficulty or annoyance, typically minor in itself but coming on top of a series of difficulties, that makes a situation unbearable.
‘His affair was the last straw’
Source: lexico.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) The last word of the proverb, ‘A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single ____’
Daily Quiz.exp:
পুরো proverbটি হবে- ‘A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
অর্থ: হাজার মাইলের যাত্রা শুরু হয় একটিমাত্র পদক্ষেপ দিয়ে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) The last word of the proverb, ‘All good things must come to an ____.’
Daily Quiz.exp:
পুরো বাক্যটা হবে - All good things must come to an end.
Meaning: A further difficulty or annoyance, typically minor in itself but coming on top of a series of difficulties, that makes a situation unbearable. / Said when you accept that even enjoyable experiences cannot last forever.
Ex: It's been a fantastic couple of weeks but all good things must come to an end.

Source: Cambridge and Oxford Dictionary.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) ‘Pull yourself together’ means-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Pull oneself together:
Meaning: Recover control of one's emotions.
‘You've got to pull yourself together and find a job’
Source: lexico.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) ‘Under the weather’ means-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Under the weather:
Meaning: Slightly unwell or in low spirits
Source: lexico.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Choose the correct one:
Daily Quiz.exp:
Deductible (adjective)
Meaning: Able to be deducted, especially from taxable income or tax to be paid.
Example: ‘childcare vouchers will be deductible expenses for employers’
Source: lexico.com

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Choose the correct sentence:
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) We involved them participate in a procession.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) We involved them participating in a procession.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) We involved them to participate in a procession.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) We involved them participated in a procession.
Daily Quiz.exp:
নিম্নলিখিত verb-গুলোর পর আরেকটি verb থাকলে তার সাথে ing যোগ করতে হয়।
সেগুলো হলঃ enjoy, suggest, miss, consider, deny, dislike, excuse, involve ইত্যাদি।

Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das
